title: PNP: 1 Chinese, 2 Malaysians behind ‘parcel scam hub’ in Pasay City
summary: MANILA, Philippines — A Chinese national and two Malaysians are the masterminds behind a “parcel scam hub” that operated for three months, said Philippine National Police (PNP)…

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A Chinese national and two Malaysians are the masterminds behind a “parcel scam hub” that operated for three months, said Philippine National Police (PNP) authorities on Tuesday. “As of now meron tayong three masterminds.
